course.title: GIS and Remote Sensing
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Suppose you have converted the geographic data of your project, either from a hardcopy or a scanned image, into vector data by digitizing the features. What kinds of errors could occur during processing? Discuss in brief with necessary examples and figures.
